content.short: Fibrous is a price-fetching protocol that navigates trade routes to identify executable options, secures optimal returns, and reduces gas fees.
content.description: Fibrous is a price-fetching protocol that aims to deliver the best possible trade execution for users. It analyzes multiple, sometimes complex, routing options to identify executable paths, seeks to secure optimal returns, and lowers gas costs with a suite of smart trading features. By evaluating routes and options across supported networks, Fibrous strives to maximize value while minimizing friction, making efficient trades more accessible across diverse markets.

resources.tldr: Agents can reason about a trade long before they can execute one safely. On the execution layer between a model's intention and an actual onchain swap.
